description.value: Forage Farm and Kitchen is a family-run farm-to-table restaurant on Hornby Island, building its seasonal menus around organically grown fruit, vegetables, berries, and edible flowers from their own farm. Located in the Ringside commercial area, the restaurant also offers vibrant cocktails and patio seating. For cyclists touring the Gulf Islands, it is one of the few year-round dining options on Hornby.
